records.subject: place/the-ashram-mount-eliza
records.summary: In January 2015 the ashram’s management said its spiritual head, Swami Shankarananda (Russell Kruckman), had had secret sexual relations with a number of women; he apologised and stepped down as director but stayed spiritual head. Yoga Australia suspended the Shiva Ashram’s accreditation in March 2015 and the organisation was later liquidated; he kept the property, now The Ashram Mount Eliza. In 2021 ABC Background Briefing reported allegations from more than 20 former devotees, including sexual assault; women’s civil claims were settled, and police questioned but never charged him.
